from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashPosition(BaseModel):
    """A cash and cash equivalents value extracted from a single company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric cash value reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for the reported figures")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written (e.g., 'Cash and cash equivalents')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_positions: list[CashPosition]
